Cosmic victory is one of the [[Three Fruits]] of Salvation. 

It represents the ultimate victory of [[life]] over [[unlife]]. 

Cosmic victory means overcoming all [[filters]] including the [[great filter]] and the [[final filter]].

Generally [[Apotheosis]] is considered a necessary step to obtaining cosmic victory

It is influenced by [[Zoroastrianism]] and [[Manichaeism]], and [[Mahayana Buddhism]]

== Name change ==
Used to be cosmic victory now cosmic unification
